brief: Inspect Underhill Bluff before the forecast heat event, prioritizing this older unit with a history of high loading as outlined in MG-023. Where the event extends beyond 48 hours with overnight minima above 24 degrees, apply the loading reduction from MG-021 starting on the third day in accordance with MG-023 and MG-025. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period as required by MG-021.
